text:
{
  "status": "partial",
  "rpwd_relevant_sections": [
    "Section 31: Free education for children with benchmark disabilities in an appropriate environment till 18 years of age",
    "Section 34: Reservation provisions in employment for persons with intellectual disabilities"
  ],
  "ncte_relevant_sections": [
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.30): Designing adapted/modified curriculum, inclusive assessment tools, and ensuring resource person support",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.32): Setting up transition criteria, designing formal transition plans, providing vocational exposure, and ensuring adequate transport facilities"
  ],
  "identified_gaps": [
    "Missing formal documentation of multi-disciplinary resource team involvement and frequency of therapeutic/special education support as required by NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.30)",
    "Lack of specified transportation and mobility safety arrangements for the external vocational internship required under NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.32)"
  ],
  "mandatory_accommodations": [
    "Formal transition plan with clearly defined criteria and transition support services pursuant to NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.32)",
    "Modified functional academic curriculum and flexible assessment tools as per NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.30)",
    "Provision of assistive technology, step-by-step visual schedule boards, and task-analyzed guides under NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.30)",
    "Free appropriate educational environment and vocational training access guaranteed under RPwD Act 2016 Section 31"
  ],
  "compliance_notes": "The IEP includes key functional goals and vocational internship targets for a 15-year-old student with intellectual disability. However, it fails to specify the required multi-disciplinary support schedule and safe transition transport protocols, resulting in partial legal compliance under RPwD Act Section 31 and NCTE/NCERT Guidelines."
}
